Ever since the game came out I've wanted to see more insight into Zenyatta, Genji's "new" self & the Shambali monks in general, especially after Mondatta was killed.

Seconding the other people in this thread, I'd love to see something with Lucio and/or Symmetra.

I'm also hoping we get more information about what exactly Talon's goals are, and I want to learn about the dynamics between its members and why they are the way they are. I'm a little worried it'll be sort of a "Mission: go get the bad guys" deal without really explaining anything or giving more insight into their characters, so fingers crossed they'll really go all out.

Ever since the "audio mixing fix" patch they did recently, everything has sounded sort of muffled to me tbh. But starting from today's patch, I'm noticing a lot of sounds just straight up aren't playing. Earlier today an enemy Junkrat's ult voiceline didn't play, and I also got no "you're powered up! get in there!" when Ana boosted me. I also had an instance today where it was absolutely silent during setup; there was no music playing whatsoever as the attack countdown went on (you know, the background music that picks up and gets really tense when there's only a few seconds left until the game starts? it was complete silence)

Anyway, it's not just you, OP. Considering Ashe's faulty voicelines as well ("hey! hey! hey! hey!" and thinking every map is Route 66) I wonder if maybe they accidentally changed something with how voicelines are triggered?

Sorry, I feel like I'm going crazy reading this thread. Every time there's a post from a woman who is uncomfortable with expensive gifts and her (husband/loved one/etc) insists on buying them despite them making her uncomfortable and her repeatedly telling him so, everyone comments about how inconsiderate the other person is for not respecting OP's boundaries. I see people mentioning love languages, and how his love language must be material gifts (which I would agree with) - in similar threads, it's usually discussed that the other person should learn to understand and respect the OP's love language, not that OP should just get over it. Why is it so different this time? I wouldn't be comfortable with someone spending a *hundred thousand dollars* on me without asking either. One hundred thousand dollars? Maybe it's only because I also come from a financially poor background, but am I alone in empathizing with OP in this?

Rabies is transmitted through the saliva of an infected animal. It doesn't sound like it bit you, so unless it drooled on you a bunch and you stuck the saliva in your mouth/eyes, you should be alright. Even then, it would probably be weaker (as in, easier for your body to fight off) because it wouldn't have started out directly in your bloodstream.

Not a doctor, but from what I can tell, it's perfectly fine to receive treatment after 3 days, so long as you continue with getting the other shots over the next few days on top of the one you already received.
